create_seq2seq_metric_reporter: create a Seq2SeqMetricReporter instance with channels and tensorizers for evaluating sequence to sequence models
calculate_seq2seq_metrics: calculate exact match, F1, and BLEU score metrics from aggregated predictions and targets
aggregate_seq2seq_targets: aggregate target sequences by removing pad tokens and storing target lengths for evaluation
aggregate_seq2seq_predictions: aggregate prediction batches into all_preds for later metric calculation during model evaluation
create_seq2seq_file_channel: create a Seq2SeqFileChannel to write doc index, raw input, predictions, and targets to a file
